name: Mieming
kurzbeschreibung: Sprawling village scattered across the sunny Mieminger Plateau, offering views of the Tschirgant mountain range.
beschreibung:
Mieming is situated at an elevation of 864 meters on the expansive Mieming Sun Plateau (Mieminger Sonnenplateau), a scenic high plateau rising south of the Inn Valley in the district of Imst. Around 3,800 residents live spread across charming hamlets including Barwies, Obermieming, Untermieming, and See. To the north, the striking Tschirgant mountain chain dominates the horizon with its 2,372-meter rocky crags, while the rugged Mieming Range with the Hohe Munde crowns the plateau to the south.

The sun plateau is renowned as one of the sunniest and mildest regions in all of Tyrol, characterized by golden larch meadows and crisp mountain air. Popular hiking excursions lead to the alpine huts of Lehnbergalm and Simmeringalm, or meander along themed trails across the gentle plateau. In winter, an extensive network of cross-country ski trails and peaceful winter hiking paths provide serene outdoor enjoyment against the dramatic backdrop of the alpine peaks.

Culinary life in Mieming features traditional Tyrolean hospitality in historic inns and comfortable farm taverns, where regional specialties like Kaiserschmarrn and hearty Gröstl are served alongside seasonal produce, making Mieming a cherished alpine haven for nature lovers and families.
